summary: E2E testing of (1) new /api/stats/champion/{name} endpoint + guest public access, (2) login screen revamp with 'Show Me The Stats!' button and no viewer/register, (3) Champion Profile page, (4) nav hover previews, (5) guest persistence & matchmaking. Backend: 7/7 pass in test_champion_stats_and_guest.py (champion profile valid/404/zero-pick; leaderboard, matrix & matchmaking anonymous access; create-match still 401 for anon). Frontend: login screen clean (no viewer, no register tab), guest-show-stats button works and lands on dashboard with 'guest' role badge + EXIT. Admin login still works and shows 'admin' badge + 'Log Match' nav. Guest nav correctly hides 'Log Match'. Hover previews render for all 9 nav items (matches, leaderboard, players, matrix, champions, matchmaking, recap, seasons, and dashboard). ChampionMatrix cm-total-Jumong is an <A> tag linking to /champions/Jumong. ChampionProfile renders champion-profile-page, role badge (Ranged), picks(6)/winrate(66.7%)/wins(4)/losses(2), Played-By table (6 players), 3 teammates, 6 opponents, Season dropdown and back link. Guest matchmaking page accessible (no redirect to /login) and refresh keeps guest on page. EXIT returns to /login.

ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard preview renders correctly but its testid is 'nav-preview-' (empty) instead of 'nav-preview-dashboard' because NavPreview derives slug from `to.replace(/\W+/g, "")` and Dashboard's to='/' strips to empty. Spec expected 'nav-preview-<path>' including dashboard.

action_items: Optional: In NavPreview.jsx, use a dedicated slug (e.g. label.toLowerCase() or map `/`->'dashboard') so Dashboard's hover preview gets data-testid='nav-preview-dashboard' per the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: NavPreview slug derivation `to.replace(/\W+/g, '')` collapses '/' to empty string — Dashboard testid becomes 'nav-preview-'. Prefer `to === '/' ? 'dashboard' : to.replace(/^\/+/,'').replace(/\W+/g,'-')`.

ChampionProfile endpoint design is solid; players[] has entries labeled 'Unknown' when a player id no longer exists — consider filtering or marking them as deleted on the backend side to avoid blank rows.

Guest mode uses localStorage flag — backend remains open; access control for write endpoints (POST /api/matches) correctly still returns 401 for unauthenticated callers, verified by test_create_match_still_requires_admin.
seed_data_creation: test_champion_stats_and_guest.py creates CTEST_ prefixed players + 1 2v2 match; cleans up players on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request features work end-to-end against the public preview URL. Only cosmetic deviation: Dashboard hover preview testid is 'nav-preview-' (empty slug). Everything else — guest flow, admin flow, champion profile, hover previews, routing, persistence, matchmaking public access — verified green.
rca of the issue: N/A — single minor deviation (testid naming) with trivial fix in NavPreview.jsx.
